businessProblem: Revenue dipped last quarter and the owner wants a single diagnosis, but the available data is partial and points in several directions at once.

evidence.finding: Revenue dipped about twelve percent but the cause is unclear; sales, pricing, and repeat behaviour all moved together
Partial figures conflict — one report shows stable profitability, another shows pressure, and neither is reconciled
Operational data for the period is incomplete and cannot confirm any single driver
Whether buyers are leaving or simply spending less is not yet distinguishable from the data
